nodes.text: [i]The shard sinks into the lantern's light, and the forge remembers.[/i]

nodes.speaker: Young Garrick
nodes.text: Twice I've bent it. The Author keeps writing me clumsy.

nodes.speaker: Young Garrick
nodes.text: A river's not a sword, Wren.
[i]Behind the memory the red voice shrieks DERIVATIVE, and for the first time it sounds a little afraid.[/i]
